section.title: Session goal
section.subtitle: Round budget for pushing on after a clean turn ends
field.defaultMaxRounds.label: Rounds a new goal gets by default
field.defaultMaxRounds.help: One automatic continuation counts as one round. The “Add rounds” button on the goal bar adds to this number; 256 is a hard cap you cannot change.
field.extendRoundsBy.label: Rounds each “Add rounds” click adds
field.extendRoundsBy.help: When the budget runs out the user decides whether to go on; each click extends it by this many rounds.
save.unknownKey: This section has no such setting: {key}
